# Landing Page Architect

Audit or write landing pages with clear offers, proof and decision paths.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Create, audit, or rewrite product and service landing pages using offer diagnosis, bottleneck-aware structure, concrete block-by-block copy, proof, risk reduction, decision details, and CTA guidance. Use when Codex is asked to write landing-page copy, choose a landing-page structure, diagnose conversion issues, improve hero/value proposition/CTA/proof/FAQ/pricing blocks, or create product, service, SaaS, AI, developer-tool, startup, lead-gen, demo-request, waitlist, consultation, local-service, or high-ticket offer pages.

Example request:

> Use landing-page-architect to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill landing-page-architect
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/landing-page-architect/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/landing-page-architect/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
